Jupiter is the largest planet in our solar system, with a diameter of about 139,822 kilometers, making it more than 11 times the width of Earth! It's a gas giant, so it doesn't have a solid surface, but its swirling clouds and storms, like the Great Red Spot, are a wonder to behold. What a glorious planet to admire!

Owls can turn their heads up to 270 degrees, which is a super cool trick for spotting prey in the dark! Some species can even rotate their heads all the way around, though they can't do that all the time. What a fascinating way to look out for the night!
